_meta.purpose: DRAFTS ONLY. 50 lineups drafted from general knowledge for the 60-match expansion. Nothing here is scheduled or seeded. Verify each against 2 independent sources (CLAUDE.md data rules), fill in sources/subs, set verification, then move the match into teamsheet-seed.json.
_meta.status_values: verification is 'unverified' for every draft until checked

draft_confidence.high: XI and subs very likely right; still needs sources
draft_confidence.medium: XI likely right; some sub minutes or positions uncertain (see flags)
draft_confidence.low: XI and/or subs partly from memory; check everything (see flags)

_meta.web_checked: Pages Claude consulted via web search on 2026-11-12 for the medium/low drafts (summarised results, not read in full). Good starting points for verification, but they do NOT count as the 2 required sources until a person confirms them and copies them into 'sources'.
_meta.notes: Starters are listed right-to-left within repeated positions (e.g. right CB before left CB). Shirt numbers omitted. A sub's 'for' player has 'off' set to the sub's 'on' minute.
